name: py-ast
description: A TypeScript library that parses Python source code into a CPython compatible AST, with full support for unparsing back to Python, tree traversal, and JSON serialization.

paragraphs: A comprehensive TypeScript-based Python source code parser that generates Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) mirroring the shape of CPython's own ast module, as defined by the Python ASDL grammar specification. This library provides complete parsing, unparsing, and AST traversal infrastructure, with bidirectional Python code ↔ AST conversion.
📖 API documentation · 🛝 Playground (Tree/JSON views of the AST, plus a Flow tab with a function-level cyclomatic-complexity call-graph heatmap)
